arm_definitions.H1-COADAPT-MASK: training-time controller logit masking from public state only; masked logits set to -1e9 before cross entropy
arm_definitions.H2-ARK014-INVARIANCE: per-epoch deterministic surface curriculum: canonical, reversed rows, uniform timestamp offset, symbol permutation
arm_definitions.H2B-NORM: controller canonicalization layer sorting observation rows by (entity, tick ascending) before rendering; un-augmented data
arm_definitions.H3-CONTRAST-MEM: 25% shape-matched replacement with stale-overwrite / consistent-control / unresolved-contradiction pairs
arm_definitions.H3B-CONTRASTIVE: cosine-margin contrastive penalty between decision-token hidden states of reversed and chronological renderings
arm_definitions.H4-OUTCOME-DELIB: outcome-verified bounded rollouts (K in 1/2/4) scored by U(tau); updates only on traces above the RLOO baseline
arm_definitions.H5-POINTER-READ: minimal pointer-copy gate plus two-read relational pooling; parameter ceiling 3,090,000 at S3
arm_definitions.H6-ARK017-CONTINUAL: b-only / replay / fresh-b / ark017-sparse replay with strictly fixed update count and logged A exposure

evaluation_family.E01: 112-world confirmation accuracy per seed and aggregate (X/112, X/336); seed inversions never hidden by averages
evaluation_family.E02: raw invalid action count across the 6,720 diagnostic records versus grammar-constrained count
evaluation_family.E03: stale-memory correction score X/48 across the six D3 memory conditions
evaluation_family.E04: row-reversal invariance delta on canonical versus reversed public rows plus consistency rate on identical valid answers
evaluation_family.E05: anti-shortcut multi-hop accuracy (D2) at 1/2/3/4 hops under scrambled timestamps and replaced distractors
evaluation_family.E06: heuristic baseline comparison: copy-last-visible, copy-max-timestamp, always-query, query-blind, random
evaluation_family.E07: net episode utility U(tau) versus the fixed controller reference 0.9714 (V6 P07)
evaluation_family.E08: query precision/recall, needless queries, successful answer updates and cost-adjusted utility
evaluation_family.E09: hidden-state linear probes: proxy mutual information I(H_L; resolved value) versus I(H_L; action legality)
evaluation_family.E10: trace diff auditor: first divergent token between paired conditions (for example t=361/t=365/t=366 rows)
evaluation_family.E11: balanced payload pair both-correct rate on counterfactual evidence swaps
evaluation_family.E12: calibration (Brier), answer entropy and per-epoch training curves with exact exposure accounting

registered.exposure_semantics: optimizer updates and supervised tokens are locked exactly to the blocked-CE baseline per arm; unpadded input positions are recorded per epoch and stay identical for H1/H2A/H2B/H4/H5, while H3 counterfactual evidence may change rendered prompt length by construction
